name: Text Statistics
description: Count words, lines, paragraphs and character classes, separating Chinese and English.

hints.text: Chinese is counted per character and English per word; their sum is the total word count.
hints.output: All counting happens on the server and the text never leaves the backend.

faq.a: Chinese characters are counted individually and English is split on whitespace and punctuation.

faq.q: Does a trailing newline add a line?
faq.a: No. A trailing blank line is not counted, matching most editors.
